import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import PercentFormatter

# Read the provided CSV and total revenue by region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
revenue_by_region = df.groupby('region', as_index=True)['revenue'].sum()
largest = revenue_by_region.max()

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(revenue_by_region.index, revenue_by_region.values)
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue (% of largest region)')
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(xmax=largest, decimals=0))
ax.set_ylim(0, largest * 1.1)
ax.set_title('Total Revenue by Region')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
